title: Freedom Customer Review Analytics
summary: A dashboard that analyses 2GIS reviews of companies in the Freedom ecosystem to understand customer experience and spot service issues across branches.

title: Kazakhstan IT Job Market Analytics
summary: Vacancies from HeadHunter, Kaspi, Kolesa and Telegram combined in one dashboard to explore salaries and skill demand in Kazakhstan's IT job market.

title: Kindergarten Accessibility in Almaty
summary: An interactive map that compares kindergarten locations with population distribution, finds underserved areas and suggests where new kindergartens are needed.

title: Astana Real Estate Analytics
summary: A machine learning app that estimates apartment prices and compares Krisha.kz listings with model predictions to flag overpriced and underpriced offers.

title: Employer Attractiveness Analytics
summary: A survey dashboard showing how respondents rate employers and which factors drive their choice of company.

title: SDU Research Publication Analytics
summary: A platform for exploring SDU's publication activity and research collaboration using Scopus and Web of Science data.

title: SDU University Review Analytics
summary: A dashboard that analyses SDU University reviews on 2GIS across 23 thematic categories to track student experience over time.
